package.name: trailer_link
package.description: Trailer (moving target) coordinate pipeline (handoff Part C): receive the trailer's position over a 900 MHz MAVLink telemetry radio on the Jetson, and convert it to a drone-local ENU relative target for the landing MPC. trailer_gps_node proves the link and republishes GLOBAL_POSITION_INT as a ROS2 fix; trailer_target_node turns that fix into a point in the vehicle's own local ENU frame, which the mission can fly to without knowing any geodesy.
